# Environtment setup

use the following code to setup the environtment `conda activate fiftyone` Must
be done before running any code snippets.

# Processes to follow

-   Write a `plan.md` to include all the items that needs to be implemented
    with checkbox. Update the checkbox and add plans as you go along.
-   Write and update a `progress.md` as you progressively build things.
-   For each major milestone, add a simple update in `milestones.md` stating
    what has been features have been achieved, what are the results, quick
    example code usage. Run and check that the example code written actually
    works.
-   Write unit tests for all major functions and test each time when there are
    changes and edit until all test pass again.
